findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1052 terminalizes every worker-launch exception with replacementSafe=true and synthesized reaped/no-residual cleanup even though the launcher may already have spawned a process. A reproduced post-spawn throw left the fixture PID alive while the receipt claimed replacement was safe. Preserve and clean the launched identity, or fail closed with replacementSafe=false and honest residual facts.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1634 returns without terminalizing an expired run when launch is granted, providerIdentity is null, and the worker PID remains alive; the cancellation path repeats the guard at line 1650. A clock-controlled wedged runner remained running after repeated post-deadline status calls. The absolute deadline must converge to timed_out with honest unknown residual/replacement safety instead of waiting forever.

packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1315 writes the signed review invocation to fd 3 using descriptor.end() without an error listener; packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:924 repeats this for the worker capability. A child closing fd 3 reproduced an unhandled EPIPE that crashed the supervisor. Settle descriptor errors through the normal failure, cleanup, and terminal path.

packages/main/src/core/finding-verify.ts:47 omits category, evidenceState, uncertaintyReason, and files from native finding signatures even though REVIEW blocking consumes evidenceState. A shape-preserving verified-to-suspected edit keeps _hash valid while turning a blocker into advisory. Bind every immutable and gate-consumed finding semantic in native sign and verification paths.

packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1669 and line 1827 unconditionally release shared provider admission after the runner returns, even when the transferred PGID-owned slot corresponds to residualProcessGroup=true and replacementSafe=false. This admits another provider while the former group can still execute. Retain the slot until the exact residual group is proven dead or safely reclaimed.

packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:739 consumes every completed managed run without requiring replacementSafe, reaped cleanup, and no residual process group before submitting the host-B verdict. Its new-run cleanup path at line 1029 also assumes cleanup is safe and removes the snapshot. A completed-but-unsafe provider result must remain blocked and its snapshot retained.

packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:968 ignores a later ordinary Codex agent_message without clearing an earlier valid managed proposal. Therefore a valid pre-terminal envelope followed by a final correction still leaves count=1 and imports the stale envelope. Proposal selection must validate the terminal assistant message, not an earlier matching message.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:204 and receipt construction at line 653 omit terminal.replacementSafe. Consequently packages/main/src/core/managed-review-evidence.ts:269 can enforce only reaped and residualProcessGroup=false, despite the import contract also requiring replacementSafe=true. Bind replacementSafe into the receipt and verify it at import and REVIEW consumption.

packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:254 and line 300 persist gate-consumable passes/findings before writing the immutable evidence binding and seal at line 303. A crash between those writes leaves admissible evidence without its import seal because packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:677 accepts both binding files being absent. Gate consumption must require the external seal, and evidence plus seal publication must be crash-consistent.

packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:448 classifies handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts as ManagedHostRun-owned, but packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:237 directly invokes runHostRun and receives admission only, with no durable ManagedHostRun identity or lifecycle. Correct the migration inventory to admission_only or route the surface through ManagedHostRun.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1185 rethrows unexpected snapshot I/O failures from an asynchronous heartbeat callback outside the worker's enclosing try/catch. The cancel and deadline callbacks at lines 1191 and 1200 have the same uncaught boundary. Such failures can terminate the detached worker without sealing terminal truth or reaping the provider; route timer failures into bounded reconciliation and cleanup.

packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1343 swallows synchronous child.stdin.end failures, allowing a provider that never received its prompt to continue and potentially be reported successful. Mark prompt-delivery failure, terminate and reap the child, and return the normal fail-closed result.
